prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished full-screen portrait mobile game popup concept, approximately 886x1920 aspect ratio (390x845 logical), edge-to-edge UI artwork, no phone frame. Input image is a STYLE AND ICON reference, redesign its daily rewards popup into CONCEPT 4: winding RACETRACK / TIMELINE.
Match reference Soft Miniature aesthetic: warm cream/beige rounded panel, soft bevels and gentle shadows, glossy toy-like 3D gem, tickets and gift icons, navy Vietnamese typography, cyan gift header, orange claim button. Dark dimmed idle racing game behind narrow outer margins.
Layout: compact cyan header with red/yellow gift at left, exact title “QUÀ HẰNG NGÀY”, red rounded X close button right. Below exact subtitle “Đăng nhập mỗi ngày, nhận quà cực chất!” and small blue pill “Đã nhận: 0 ngày”.
Main daily track: a tasteful warm charcoal-gray asphalt racetrack with white dashed center lines blending naturally into cream background. Seven days follow a connected serpentine route: row one left-to-right Day1,Day2,Day3; curved connection right edge; row two right-to-left Day4,Day5,Day6 (visually show Ngày 6 left, Ngày 5 center, Ngày 4 right). Then track flows to wide Day7 finish podium below. The first SIX reward nodes must be exactly equal-size large circular badges, with centered reward icon, day label above circle and a little quantity pill below icon. Spacious enough to read but compact with no waste. Day1 gold highlighted circle and little flag “HÔM NAY”.
EXACT first six visible day contents (the reward names here describe ICONS ONLY, NEVER print names):
“Ngày 1”: blue Pro ticket icon from reference, quantity “2”.
“Ngày 2”: silver blue Standard ticket icon from reference, quantity “2”.
“Ngày 3”: purple gem icon, quantity “15”.
“Ngày 4”: purple gold All-Star ticket icon from reference, quantity “1”.
“Ngày 5”: golden Elite ticket icon from reference, quantity “1”.
“Ngày 6”: purple gem icon, quantity “20”.
Within each daily node, render ONLY “Ngày N”, icon, and numeric quantity, plus the HÔM NAY flag for day1. Absolutely no gem or ticket reward names on any daily node.
DAY7: big cyan cream/gold edged finish reward card/podium with small checkered finish flags, large glossy gift box on left, exact heading “NGÀY 7 · QUÀ ĐẶC BIỆT”. Purple gem icon with numeric “30”, plus purple/gold All-Star ticket icon with numeric “2”. Finish track details. NO completion progress strip and NO phrase “Hoàn thành 7 ngày để nhận”.
Bottom cumulative section: exact title “QUÀ TÍCH LŨY” with blue progress pill “0/10 ngày”; elegant small horizontal milestone rail, four evenly-spaced milestones labeled “Ngày 10”, “Ngày 20”, “Ngày 30”, “Ngày 40”. Rewards respectively: gem icon + “40”; All-Star ticket icon + “2”; gem icon + “80” and All-Star ticket icon + “2”; gem icon + “40”. Compact clear icon+number layout, no reward names necessary.
Bottom large glossy orange rounded button with little gift icon and exact large white text “NHẬN QUÀ”.
Typography crisp readable Vietnamese with all diacritics, harmonious hierarchy. Premium production-ready casual racing idle game UI. All content fits inside image. Do not add any extra banners or text. No watermarks. Preserve accurate day order along route, no duplicate days, six equal round badges and larger finish Day7.
